name: Pension Aloisia
beschreibung: The Gasthof Pension Aloisia is located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in the Tiroler Sölllandl. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain world of the Wilder Kaiser and offer hiking trails in summer as well as access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental in winter. The accommodation has practically furnished rooms, some with a balcony and mountain view. The dining room serves traditional Tiroler cuisine. The atmosphere is traditional and family-like. The target group is couples, families, and active holidaymakers seeking a quiet base for outdoor activities.
